What are tasty foods to eat after getting my wisdom teeth pulled out?

When I had mine taken out last year, the first few days I had to have yogurt and ice cream for a few meals. I wouldn't recommend soup. You'll be able to eat normal foods again after a few days if you ease in to it. Maybe try a cheese souffle!
I drank protein shakes and ate blue bell ice cream...RIP blue bell I miss thee

Froyo, French fries, like steak fries so they're softer. Soft foods like raspberries or avocado. Those chicken noodle soup packets that have the mini noodles. I think Lipton is the brand. Scrambled eggs. Baked potatoes. Think baby food. Hope you heal up quick! Getting my teeth pulled out was easy. The diet restrictions were the most difficult thing to deal with. I love food.
Just stay away from the corn chips

Everything that does fit into your blender. Just add water to make things drinkable.

If you don't have a blender and are short on cash, just get a cheap stick blender. Mine was 9€ and has served me well for over a year now.

When I got mine removed this time last year, all I could eat for who about 5 days was rice pudding. It was delicious though. The vanilla doesn't make it too sweet, and the texture is really easy to get used to.

The last one I had done, I lived on soup (Im lazy so i just bought a bunch of those campbell's soup to go cups that you microwave), gelatin, and pudding for about a week. Anything made out of surimi (basically anything made of finely pureed and reformed meat, think like chicken nuggets, hot dogs, fake crab meat, etc) you can probably get away with after the first day or two but it kinda depends on how high the risk is that you'll dislodge the blood clot.

Make your own ice cream. Ben & Jerry's put out an excellent cookbook that I and my family have used to make some amazing things. Modify the maple walnut recipe a bit to make maple bacon ice cream. Delicious stuff.
Mashed potato, just make sure it's not hot.

Guacamole queso (Blender recipe) Ingredients

8   oz cream cheese diced

1/4 c + 2 Tbs sour cream

2 avocados

2   green onions, trimmed and roughly chopped

2 garden tomatoes

2   oz shredded cheddar cheese

3   tbsp cilantro

1⁄8   tsp garlic powder

1   tbsp fresh lime juice

1⁄2   tsp chili powder

1⁄2   tsp kosher or sea salt

1⁄8   tsp paprika

1⁄8   tsp cayenne pepper

1⁄4   tsp ground cumin

1/4c milk

Add ingredients to jar in order listed and secure lid. Press "Pulse" 7-9 times to chop the ingredients. Use a rubber scraper to push the ingredients close to the blade. Increase the speed to Speed 1 and run for 1-20 seconds until ingredients are well-mixed. Serve as is or Pour into serving dish and chill for 2-3 hours before serving.

Alternative: Serve warm by heating in the microwave or toaster oven.
